data.body:
Held-out RED oracle proven before repair. Contract card: authoritative_contract=prior closed bug innovative-dandruffy-deer establishes fixture-only bounded exact-call recovery while production authorship stays fail-closed; trigger=the first real broad git-log and first real per-event git-log each return one injected rc128, rc0/empty, or BlockingIOError(EAGAIN), then the identical calls run against unchanged real fixture history; tier=unit test with a real temporary Git topology because parser/history equivalence must execute for real; observable_postcondition=all exact batched position->SHA values equal non-None per-event oracle SHAs, with two broad attempts and one additional narrow attempt; negative_control=persistent failure stops at five with fsck/count-objects diagnostics; gate=make test.

Final transient oracle was collected and executed (not skipped/xfail) for all three modes. Before any repair it failed for the expected mechanism: each recovered batched SHA was compared to None from the one-shot per-event oracle. Result: 3 failed in 2.12s, exact assertion `batched[position] == authorship.resolve_event_commit(...)`. The oracle patch was then physically removed; the worktree is clean, so the held-out fixer cannot inspect its fixture changes or assertions.
